description: Todo List REST API - Simple CRUD operations for task management

userStories.title: Initialize project structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a clean project structure with Express and SQLite setup.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json exists with express and better-sqlite3 dependencies
src/index.js creates Express app listening on port 3000
src/database.js initializes SQLite with a todos table

userStories.title: Implement GET /api/todos endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want to list all todos so that I can see my tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Response includes id, title, completed, created_at fields

userStories.title: Implement POST /api/todos endpoint
userStories.description: As a user, I want to create new todos so that I can track tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/todos with title creates a todo
Returns 201 with the created todo object
Missing title returns 400 with error message

userStories.title: Implement PATCH and DELETE endpoints
userStories.description: As a user, I want to update and delete todos to manage my task list.
